assumptions: Coordinator posts2*763;4% average monthly separation+9% annual personal mobility applied once annually.

reconstruction_issues: JOLTS monthly flow average used as annual separation rate.

Fewer-than10 subset exclusion needs PRA scope review;not a legal conclusion.
No program changes narrative versus large discretion decrease in package.
